chunks: And in the narration of Jamil ibn Darraj, from one of the two of them عليهما السلام,
The one who is ignorant in leaving the two rakʿahs at Maqam Ibrahim عليه السلام is in the position of one who forgets.

key_terms.الْجَاهِلَ: the person who does not know the ruling
key_terms.بِمَنْزِلَةِ: having the same legal status as
key_terms.جَمِيلِ: Jamil, the named narrator in the report
key_terms.مَقَامِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ: the Station of Ibrahim عليه السلام near the Kaʿbah

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on someone who leaves the two rakʿahs at Maqam Ibrahim out of ignorance?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the two rakʿahs performed at Maqam Ibrahim عليه السلام after tawaf. It states that a person who omits them out of ignorance is treated like one who forgot, indicating a shared legal status between ignorance and forgetfulness in this case.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.2834 - In a narration by Jamil ibn Darraj from one of the Imams (as), it is stated:
"The one who is ignorant in leaving the two Rak'ahs at the Station of Ibrahim (as) is treated as one who forgets."
